description:
Aggregate the work that delivers this outcome: graph assertions and the type hierarchy are typed and validated when declarations load.

## Background

This story groups the tasks of epic 2195c98f that share one design surface, so they can be reviewed together once each has landed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each graph assertion is decoded into a typed configuration at load, with patterns compiled, and a malformed assertion fails loading naming the rule.
- [hard] REQ-02: `HierarchyConfig` is built from declarations by one fallible constructor with one error policy.
title: Declarations are typed and compiled at load
